description: Knowledge base for Step 6 - Privacy Declaration in a Water Licence Application. Covers legal authority for data collection, how personal information is used, and full text of relevant FOIPPA sections.

source_document.title: Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FOIPPA)

knowledge_items.title: Legal Authority for Data Collection
knowledge_items.content: Personal information is collected by FrontCounter BC under the legal authority of section 26(c) and 27(1)(a)(i) of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (the Act).

knowledge_items.title: FOIPPA Governs Data Use
knowledge_items.content: The collection, use, and disclosure of personal information is subject to the provisions of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (the Act).

knowledge_items.title: How Personal Information Is Used
knowledge_items.content: Personal information will be used to process inquiries or applications. It may also be shared when strictly necessary with partner agencies subject to the Act. It may also be used for referrals, notifications, and survey purposes.

knowledge_items.title: Contact Information for Privacy Questions
knowledge_items.content: For more information regarding collection, use, or disclosure of personal information, contact FrontCounter BC at 1-877-855-3222 or 441 Columbia Street, Kamloops, BC V2C 2T3.

contact.address: FrontCounter BC Program Director, FrontCounter BC Provincial Operation, 441 Columbia Street, Kamloops, BC V2C 2T3

knowledge_items.title: Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act
knowledge_items.content: Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FOIPPA) governs the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information by public bodies in British Columbia.

knowledge_items.title: Unauthorized Collection, Use and Disclosure Prohibited
knowledge_items.content: An employee, officer or director of a public body or an employee or associate of a service provider must not collect, use or disclose personal information except as authorized by this Act.

knowledge_items.title: Purpose for Collection
knowledge_items.content: A public body may collect personal information only if it is authorized under an Act, for law enforcement, or if it relates directly to and is necessary for a program or activity, or with consent where appropriate, or for planning, evaluation, domestic violence prevention, public events observation, or identity services under section 69.2.

knowledge_items.title: How Personal Information is Collected
knowledge_items.content: A public body must collect personal information directly from the individual unless authorized otherwise. Individuals must be informed of purpose, legal authority, and contact information unless exceptions apply. Employees must be notified unless it compromises accuracy, availability, or investigations.

knowledge_items.title: When Information is Not Considered Collected
knowledge_items.content: Personal information is not considered collected if it does not relate to a program or activity and is only read and then deleted, destroyed, returned, or transferred. It may be transferred to another public body or government institution if it relates to their program or activity.
